data.name: Cristin
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Christus', meaning 'anointed one'. In Christian tradition, the name Cristin symbolizes the belief in the savior, Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith and devotion to Jesus Christ.

in_hebrew.name: קריסטין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קריסטין נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'Χρήστος' (כריסטוס), שפירושה המשוחה או המושיע. השם קשור קשר הדוק לישו המשיח בברית החדשה. השם קריסטין מבטא נאמנות לאלוהים והתייחדות עם דמותו של ישו. השימוש בשם זה בקרב הנוצרים מתחיל מימי הביניים ומסמל על קשר רוחני עמוק עם הדת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Κριστίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κριστίν προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'Χρήστος' που σημαίνει ο Μεσσίας ή ο Χριστός. Ο Χρήστος είναι χαρακτηρισμός του Ιησού στη Καινή Διαθήκη. Το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Κριστίν συνδέεται με την πνευματική σχέση με τον Ιησού και την αποστολή του ως Σωτήρος.

in_latin.name: Cristin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cristin a voce Graeca 'Χρήστος' (Christus) derivatur, quae unctum seu Messiam significat. Hoc nomen in usu Christianorum a medio aevo incepit et fidem ac devotionem ad Deum exprimit. Christus enim in Novum Testamentum Iesu Christi titulus est, qui pro peccatis hominum unctus et electus est.

in_english.name: Cristin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cristin originates from the Greek word 'Χρήστος' (Christos), meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah'. This term is directly associated with Jesus Christ in the New Testament. The name signifies a deep spiritual connection and loyalty to God. Historically, Cristin has been used among Christians since the Middle Ages. It symbolizes faith, devotion, and the Christian values associated with the figure of Christ. The name reflects a strong religious heritage and is often chosen for its profound spiritual significance.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the root 'Χρήστος' (Christos) is a significant title for Jesus Christ.

data.cultural_impact: Cristin is a name rooted in Christian tradition. It was common among early Christians as a direct reference to Jesus Christ, emphasizing the belief in His divinity and salvation.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Cristin signifies a deep spiritual connection to the Christian faith. It serves as a reminder of the saving grace of Jesus Christ, emphasizing His role as the anointed one and the bearer of salvation.

name_in_real_life.story: Sarah Cristin from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Cristin - "Christ". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Cristin, meaning "follower of Christ," embodies the spiritual commitment to walk in the footsteps of Jesus. This name symbolizes a deep connection to the divine, inviting one to live a life rooted in faith and love.
